'''Mound mites''' were garbage-dwelling creatures of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A [[Mutant|mutated]] one was known to have terrorized residents of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mound mites appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
